case.title: Before anyone reorders them, a group's work orders follow List's default sort
case.custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner or Admin user whose role has Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit, at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • Your browser window is at least 1024 px wide, so the display switcher (List, Tech View, Board View) shows at the right of the Work Orders toolbar.
  • User {User-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST Sort Viewer) is a new staff member with the Admin role at {Location-A}, can sign in, and has never changed or saved a sort in List.
  • Technician {Technician-A} (for example Kristin Watson) is an active staff member at {Location-A} with Time Clock on and a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User. {Technician-A} leads no other work order.
  • Customers {Customer-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Sort Alpha Freight"), {Customer-B} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Sort Mid Trucking") and {Customer-C} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Sort Zeta Hauling") start with the same words (for example ZZAUTOTEST F2 Sort) and are used by this case only.
  • Four Approved work orders, all led by {Technician-A}, were created in this order: {Work-order-1} (for example S10043-17621) for {Customer-C}, {Work-order-2} (for example S10043-17622) for {Customer-A}, {Work-order-3} (for example S10043-17623) for {Customer-B} and {Work-order-4} (for example S10043-17624) for {Customer-B}.
  • Nobody has reordered {Technician-A}'s work orders at {Location-A}.
  • On the Work Orders page nothing is ticked in Status, Asset on Site shows no choice (if its chip shows Yes or No, click the x on the chip), Assigned to me is off and Search is empty.
case.custom_steps:
1. Sign in as {User-B}.
  2. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and click List in the display switcher.
  3. Type the shared start of the three customer names (for example ZZAUTOTEST F2 Sort) in Search.
  4. Write down the order of the four work orders in List.
  5. Click Tech View in the display switcher.
  6. Write down the order of the rows in {Technician-A}'s group.
  7. Click Board View in the display switcher.
  8. Write down the order of the cards in {Technician-A}'s column.
case.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: List shows the four work orders in its usual default order: by customer name from A to Z (with the example names: {Customer-A}, then {Customer-B}'s two work orders, then {Customer-C}).
  • Step 6: Tech View's rows are in exactly the same order as List at step 4, including the order of {Customer-B}'s two work orders, {Work-order-3} and {Work-order-4}.
  • Step 8: Board View's cards are in the same order as Tech View's rows.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10045 (Story 2, Tech View — table grouped by lead technician); PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 54 (15 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S2-R6, read 15 Oct 2026. Review Decisions 853901313 DR-45 (desktop List default sort is customer name A to Z; its description of the tie-break was corrected by Chris Ward on 15 Oct 2026 in PRD version 53: same customer, start date, newest first, exactly as the List sorts today). Source-verified 15 October 2026. Last checked against build v26.40.19-1493c63 (staging) on 10/16/2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R6: “Before a manual order is saved, use the List’s default work order sort, ties included, exactly as the List sorts today: work orders for the same customer go by start date, newest first. The List itself does not change. A work order that gets a new lead after it was created goes to the bottom of that technician’s work instead (S9-R14).”

  6. Use a user who has never saved a sort in List (e.g. a newly created user), so List shows its default sort.

changes.new_value:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 2 users · 1 browser · about 20 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011). A desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  • The case is run as [User-B]: a user who has never saved a sort in List (e.g. a newly created user: Role Admin, which holds Work orders > View; Time Clock off), so List shows its default sort.
  • [User-A]: an Owner/Admin user who creates the data (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders).
  • One location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); everything below is created in this location.
  • One technician at this location, [Tech-A] (e.g. "Kristin Watson"), who leads no other work order. A person only counts as a technician here when the staff member is active (not deactivated), Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customers "Zeta Hauling", "Alpha Freight" and "Mid Trucking" (named in the expected results, so kept as they are), each with one contact and one asset.
  • Three Approved work orders led by [Tech-A], created in this order: [WO-1] for Zeta Hauling, [WO-2] for Alpha Freight, [WO-3] for Mid Trucking.
  • What must hold: [Tech-A] leads exactly these three work orders.

Setup

  1. Sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page (you appear as "Admin ShopView"). Check the location in the top bar next to the bell; to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location.
  2. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: confirm each technician below is active at this location with Time Clock on, or add it: New Staff Member > First Name and Last Name, an Email, Role "Technician", at least one Department (required), Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close. Record them as [Tech-A] (e.g. Kristin Watson; use a new technician if your choice already leads other work orders).
  3. Settings > Staff > New Staff Member > First Name and Last Name, an email you can open, Role "Admin", at least one Department (required), Location = this location, Time Clock off > Save & Close. Accept the invitation from that email and set a password. Record this user as [User-B].
  4. Top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "Zeta Hauling" > Save (if it already exists, open it instead). On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, TRK-118) > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty. Do the same for "Alpha Freight" and "Mid Trucking".
  5. Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick Customer "Zeta Hauling" and its asset > Save. The work order opens on its Lines tab with the New Line form open: in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; the build offers only ready-made lines), turn Line Approved on > Save & Close; the work order becomes Approved. Repeat for Alpha Freight, then Mid Trucking, in that order; record the numbers as [WO-1] (Zeta Hauling), [WO-2] (Alpha Freight) and [WO-3] (Mid Trucking) (numbers on this site look like "S10043-17581").
  6. Set the leads: on an Approved work order pick the technician in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page; it saves at once. (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned. Here: [WO-1], [WO-2] and [WO-3] = [Tech-A].
  7. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > Tech View — [Tech-A]'s group holds exactly [WO-1], [WO-2] and [WO-3]. If it holds more, reassign the extra ones or start again with a new technician.

  • In Tech View the rows are in List's default order: Alpha Freight, Mid Trucking, Zeta Hauling (customer name A-Z), the same order List shows.
